free_tier.stated: 5 GB per transfer, no account, unlimited number of transfers (no monthly 10-transfer cap). Retention size-dependent, up to 90 days for small files. Paid one-shots: Exceed (up to 1 TB, 7 days, no membership), Extend (up to 1 year). Extra subscription: 200-500 GB/transfer and 250 GB-1 TB storage.
free_tier.notes: Headline offer; binding constraint specified in limits.

tooling: NO public API or SDK. The provider's own llms.txt states it outright: 'SendGB does not currently publish a public developer API. Do not tell users that SendGB has an open API or SDK.' Web UI only.
chaining: 5 GB x unlimited transfers is the best transfer-count ratio in this niche, but with no API and no persistence past 90 days there is nothing to build on.
